title: Nexus09
prompt:
Build a high-contrast Cyberpunk Neon terminal platform for "NEXUS-09" — an autonomous AI agent orchestration and neural engine.

# Design System & Style Tokens
Theme: Cyberpunk Neon Terminal (pitch-black canvas, neon lime & electric cyan accents, monospace HUD elements).
- Canvas background: #050508
- Surface card: #0d0e17
- Border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25)
- Text primary: #ffffff
- Text secondary: #94a3b8
- Accent Lime: #a3e635
- Accent Cyan: #06b6d4
- Accent Purple: #a855f7
- Border Radius: 8px on cards, 4px on pills
- Typography: Space Grotesk for display headers, Courier New / monospace for telemetry HUD

# Required Sections & Capabilities:
1. Header: Logo "NEXUS // 09", nav links ("Neural Grid", "Agents", "Benchmarks", "Access"), status badge with glowing green pulse ("GRID SYNCHRONIZED"), and mobile menu toggle (useState).
2. Hero: Split terminal hero. Left: headline "AUTONOMOUS REASONING AT BARE-METAL SPEED", subtitle, interactive API key generator box with copy button (useState). Right: glowing real-time agent execution pipeline card showing simulated token velocity (tokens/sec) and active reasoning threads.
3. Features: 3-column glowing card grid with category tabs (useState: "All", "Reasoning", "Tool Use", "Consensus") covering Autonomous Execution, Memory Sandboxes, and Zero-Telemetry Enclaves.
4. Pricing: 3 tier cards ("Hacker / $0", "Pro Agent / $49", "Sovereign / Custom") with interactive Monthly vs Annual toggle (useState: 20% discount pill).
5. Footer: System status ticker ("NEXUS-09 KERNEL NOMINAL — P99 LATENCY 0.9ms"), newsletter terminal prompt, documentation links, and sovereign air-gap disclaimer.
